Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to accurately synthesize the information gathered from the WebSurfer agent in Step 2. While the WebSurfer correctly identified the firm's services as "Organizational Consulting & Leadership Advisory" (visible in the page title and meta description) and listed "Executive Search" as a specific service function, the Planner incorrectly concluded that the firm's field was "Private Equity." This error stems from misinterpreting the navigation menu item "Industries > Private Equity" as the firm's primary field, rather than recognizing it as just one of many industry sectors the firm serves. The Planner ignored the explicit service descriptions provided on the homepage in favor of a single industry category, leading to an inaccurate final answer.
